speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with a breast mass; to begin our evaluation, how old are you, and when did you first notice this lump? Are you currently pregnant or breastfeeding, and do you have a family history of breast cancer?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Phyllodes Tumor. The patient is a 48-year-old woman with a rapidly enlarging breast mass over 4 weeks, which is highly characteristic of a Phyllodes tumor rather than a simple fibroadenoma or carcinoma.
